name: EXECUTOR_EFFECT_CLAIM_RETRY_LQ1349_20261109
comment: RUN_REFUSED and dead-lettered on attempt 1 (effect:effect_store_unavailable) because a single transient
sqlite lock on EffectGate.begin()'s claim (receipt 5.1 s = the connection's busy timeout) ended the slot.
The gate pins: locked/busy is retried a bounded three attempts with 0.25/0.5 s backoff; every other
sqlite error, the missing store and a refusal result keep the fail-closed RUN_REFUSED with the same
reason string; a retried claim records claim_retries. Hermetic: a duck-typed store, no ledger, no spawn.
